syntheses.title: Contradiction in Input and Output Representations Between End-to-End CNN and ChauffeurNet RNN Methods
syntheses.body: Paper A describes a method where a CNN learns the entire processing pipeline to steer an automobile, generating steering commands directly from single front-facing center camera images (claims e66d15a0-9347-5814-b053-1ff1dea8058d, 70eb8202-ac82-55fb-a95a-efb095234403). In contrast, Paper B presents ChauffeurNet, an RNN that takes mid-level input representations and outputs driving trajectories for control rather than direct steering commands (claims cc49c2d4-b50d-5322-8525-304268249b24, 639f88c8-001d-587a-bae9-390fb3c89dcf). This reveals a contradiction in the fundamental approach to input and output representations for autonomous driving control between the two methods.
